hits.title: OrbACE: Orbital and Atomic Cluster Expansion
hits.abstract_snippet: Accurate electronic-structure reference data are expensive, motivating interatomic potentials that learn effectively from limited training sets. hits.title: Toggle Tree: A New Data Structure for Efficient Parallel Graph Processing
hits.abstract_snippet: We present the Toggle Tree, a parallel data structure for frontier-based graph algorithms. A Toggle Tree is used to represent a subset of vertices using hierarchical bit vectors, enabling efficient parallel updates, traversal, and set-wise reductions without global packing. hits.abstract_snippet: Covariate-aware time-series foundation models (TSFMs) condition their forecasts on additional input variables, called covariates, that are supplied over the future horizon.
